subtitle: A Cozy Mystery Word Search Book: 50 Chapters, 50 Puzzles and One Killer to Unmask
blurb: The Pennywhistle Harbor Harvest Bake-Off was supposed to be the sweetest day of the year. Then the famous food critic Lionel Crane took one bite of plum cake and collapsed at the judging table. Hattie Bramble, retired schoolteacher and owner of the Rolling Pin Bakery, knows her friend Delia never poisoned anyone. With her tabby cat Biscuit at her heels and her nephew on the local police force, Hattie starts asking questions. Read a short chapter, then solve the word search built from it. But watch closely: in 21 of the puzzles, one word on the list is missing from the grid. Each missing word is a clue. Collect all 21 in your Detective's Notebook, solve the Final Reveal, and the leftover letters will spell out the name of the killer. Fifty chapters, fifty-one puzzles, large clear print and full solutions.
setting: Pennywhistle Harbor, a small fishing village on the coast of Maine, during the week of the autumn Harvest Bake-Off. Key places: the Rolling Pin Bakery on the village square, the Gull's Rest Inn and its walled garden and potting shed, the striped tea tent on the green, Winnie's bookshop, the harbor, and the lighthouse.

sleuth.name: Hattie Bramble
sleuth.job: retired schoolteacher who now runs the Rolling Pin Bakery
sleuth.trait: never forgets a face or a recipe, and writes everything down in a little green notebook

victim.name: Lionel Crane
victim.who: a famous and sharp-tongued television food critic and cookbook author, invited as head judge of the Harvest Bake-Off

suspects.name: Delia Fairweather
suspects.role: owner of the Sugar and Spoon bakery across the square
suspects.motive: Lionel's cruel review closed her first cafe in Boston years ago

suspects.name: Rupert Ashby
suspects.role: owner of the Gull's Rest Inn, where Lionel was staying
suspects.motive: deep in debt, and Lionel had offered to buy the inn for a fraction of its worth

suspects.name: Colette Marsh
suspects.role: Lionel's quiet personal assistant for twelve years
suspects.motive: Lionel built his famous cookbook on her recipes and planned to fire her and publish her new book under his own name

suspects.name: Gordon Pike
suspects.role: harbor master and chairman of the bake-off committee
suspects.motive: Lionel knew Gordon had rigged old bake-off results and was pressing him for favors

suspects.name: Imogen Vale
suspects.role: Lionel's estranged niece, a painter who lives by the lighthouse
suspects.motive: she stands to inherit Lionel's house and savings

solution: Colette Marsh poisoned Lionel because he stole her recipes and was about to fire her and take her new book. She steeped foxglove leaves from the inn garden in his morning tea, sweetened it with honey to hide the bitter taste, and forged an order so that Delia's plum cake would be blamed when he collapsed at the tasting.

outline.title: The Week of the Bake-Off
outline.beat: Hattie bakes at dawn while the village buzzes about the famous critic Lionel Crane coming to judge the Harvest Bake-Off.

outline.title: A Very Particular Guest
outline.beat: Lionel arrives at the Gull's Rest Inn, insults Hattie's scones, and his assistant Colette carefully unpacks his monogrammed teacup.

outline.title: Dinner with Daggers Drawn
outline.beat: At the welcome dinner Hattie notices that Delia, Rupert, Gordon and Imogen each bristle at Lionel.

outline.title: Steam in the Blue Suite
outline.beat: Delivering pastries to the inn at dawn, Hattie glimpses a travel kettle steaming in Lionel's suite.

outline.title: Trouble in the Tea Tent
outline.beat: During judging Lionel tastes Delia's plum cake, then collapses at the table and is rushed away.

outline.title: Grim News on the Green
outline.beat: Deputy Sam Bramble tells his aunt that Lionel has died and the doctor suspects poison; Delia's cake is taken away.

outline.title: Something in the Garden
outline.beat: Walking Biscuit past the inn's walled garden, Hattie spots freshly cut foxglove stalks.

outline.title: Whispers About Delia
outline.beat: Gossip turns against Delia, and Hattie decides she cannot sit by while her friend is blamed.

outline.title: The Empty Hook
outline.beat: In the inn's potting shed Hattie finds an empty hook where the garden shears should hang.

outline.title: Cocoa and a Suspect List
outline.beat: Hattie and Winnie from the bookshop draw up a list of suspects over cocoa after closing time.

outline.title: Laundry Day at the Inn
outline.beat: Helping the inn's housekeeper, Hattie finds an apron with odd green stains in the laundry basket.

outline.title: An Innkeeper's Worries
outline.beat: Hattie learns that Rupert is deep in debt and that Lionel had offered to buy the inn cheaply.

outline.title: Old Scorecards
outline.beat: At the harbor Gordon Pike acts nervous when Hattie mentions the bake-off scorecards from years past.

outline.title: A Taste He Hated
outline.beat: Sam lets slip that Lionel's teacup held traces of honey, though Lionel was famous for hating honey.

outline.title: The Painter by the Light
outline.beat: Imogen Vale visits the bakery, admits she inherits Lionel's house, and says she was painting at the lighthouse.

outline.title: Lost and Found
outline.beat: In the inn's lost-and-found box Hattie finds a train ticket stub dated a day before the bake-off guests arrived.

outline.title: Twelve Years of Tea
outline.beat: Colette tells Hattie how devoted she was to Lionel and says she spent the bake-off morning at the library.

outline.title: Recipes in the Margins
outline.beat: A guest leaves a handwritten recipe notebook at the bakery, and its recipes match Lionel's famous cookbook.

outline.title: A Nasty Note
outline.beat: Someone tapes a cruel note to Delia's shop window, and Hattie helps her clean it away.

outline.title: Biscuit Knocks a Jar
outline.beat: While Hattie bakes, Biscuit knocks over a spice jar and gives her an idea about timing.

outline.title: A Package for a Dead Man
outline.beat: A courier delivers a parcel for Lionel to Winnie's bookshop: a publishing contract for a new cookbook in his name alone.

outline.title: The Harbor Master Confesses
outline.beat: Gordon admits he once rigged the bake-off for his late sister and that Lionel was pressuring him about it.

outline.title: Words Never Sent
outline.beat: In the inn's writing desk Hattie finds a draft letter from Lionel firing someone close to him.

outline.title: Stay Out of It, Aunt Hattie
outline.beat: Sam warns Hattie to stop poking around because the county detective is focused on Delia.

outline.title: The Innkeeper's Fib
outline.beat: Hattie catches Rupert in a lie about where he was on the morning of the bake-off.

outline.title: A Scent in the Shed
outline.beat: Back in the potting shed Hattie catches the faint smell of lavender hand cream.

outline.title: A Fisherman's Word
outline.beat: A fisherman confirms he saw Imogen at the lighthouse early that morning, though not the whole time.

outline.title: Biscuit Digs In
outline.beat: Biscuit digs under a hydrangea in the inn garden and uncovers a muddy trowel.

outline.title: The Village Rallies
outline.beat: Delia is named a person of interest, and Hattie rallies the village to buy from her shop.

outline.title: Small Muddy Boots
outline.beat: Hattie notices a pair of small muddy boots drying on the inn's back porch.

outline.title: Rupert Comes Clean
outline.beat: Rupert confesses he was meeting a bank officer in secret, not poisoning anyone.

outline.title: Candlelight and Clues
outline.beat: A storm knocks out the power, and Hattie and Winnie review every clue by candlelight.

outline.title: Leaves in a Guidebook
outline.beat: Tucked inside a guidebook in the inn's reading room, Hattie finds an envelope of crushed dried leaves.

outline.title: Clear Skies for Gordon
outline.beat: Radio logs prove Gordon was at the harbor office all morning, so Hattie crosses him off.

outline.title: Left Behind in the Tent
outline.beat: Hattie rescues a saucer from the tea tent's leftover crockery, and Sam sends it to the lab.

outline.title: Stick to Pies
outline.beat: A note slipped under the bakery door warns Hattie to stick to pies.

outline.title: Who Knew the Schedule
outline.beat: The judging timetable shows that only the judges' staff knew when the plum cake would be tasted.

outline.title: The Will That Wasn't
outline.beat: Imogen reveals Lionel had never changed his will, which clears away her motive.

outline.title: Shelves of Seed Catalogs
outline.beat: Hattie spends an afternoon in the inn's reading room among old gardening books and seed catalogs.

outline.title: A Pressed Leaf
outline.beat: In a gardening book Hattie finds a pressed foxglove leaf used as a bookmark.

outline.title: Not Enough for Sam
outline.beat: Hattie shares her worries with Sam, who says he needs real proof.

outline.title: A Hand That Wasn't Delia's
outline.beat: The order form for Delia's plum cake carries a forged signature that is not Delia's.

outline.title: The Cake Was Clean
outline.beat: Lab results show the saucer held foxglove but the cake was clean, and Delia is cleared.

outline.title: Closed on Tuesdays
outline.beat: The librarian says the library was closed that morning, so one suspect's alibi falls apart.

outline.title: An Invitation to Tea
outline.beat: Hattie invites all five suspects to a thank-you tea at the Rolling Pin.

outline.title: Honey and Lavender
outline.beat: At the tea Hattie chats about honey and lavender and watches one cup rattle on its saucer.

outline.title: The Photograph
outline.beat: Winnie shows Hattie a snapshot from bake-off morning with a figure slipping out of the inn garden at dawn.

outline.title: The Green Notebook
outline.beat: Late at night Hattie lays out every clue in her notebook and the pieces fall together.

outline.title: The Same Hand
outline.beat: Hattie compares the writing on an old recipe card with the forged signature, and they match.

outline.title: Sunset in the Garden
outline.beat: Hattie gathers everyone in the inn garden at sunset and raises her hand to name the killer.
